title: Support grants
description: Time-boxed, read-only access into a tenant (D-090): requested by Support, approved by the tenant's Owner in-app or by a platform admin for an incident. Every read is audited.
emptyHint: Ask the tenant's Owner for access from the tenant's Support tab.
requestHint: The Owner sees the reason and the ticket and approves for a few hours. The access is read-only.
approveTitle: Open {name} to Support for an incident?
approveBody: Without the Owner's approval, for: {reason}. Audited as an incident approval; type the ticket to confirm.
revokeBody: Support loses access to {name} at once.
liveHint: A grant is active: Support can read this tenant until it ends.
noLiveHint: No active grant: Support cannot read this tenant's data. Ask the Owner for access.
bypassHint: As a platform admin you read without a grant; every read is audited as a bypass.

view.bannerBody: You are reading this tenant's data under a support grant. Nothing can be changed from here, and every read is recorded in the tenant's audit log.
view.readsHint: Every read by Support or a platform admin, including yours on this page.
